items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 May 2026 5:05pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 22 May 2026 at 5:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers mainland Europe, while low pressure covers the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, but variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area at first and again later, decreasing Southwest 3 or 4 in all waters overnight. Backing South or Southwest again tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight overnight, but remaining smooth or slight in the southeast of the area throughout.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches, then occasional rain this evening, becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor in mist or very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, but variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area, increasing South or Southwest 4 or 5 in all waters tomorrow evening. Decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate, but smooth or slight in the southeast of the area.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
